purpose: Turn explicitly operative analysis routes into deterministic private adjudication obligations without opening work from diagnostic-only thresholds.
Assign required cases across the two qualified dedicated adjudicators subject to topic coverage, conflict, prior-label-exposure, and role-separation constraints.
Preserve both accepted initial ratings and permit only append-only object-level reratings from the original raters.
Allow a case to close with a supported resolution, after a valid rerating, or as explicitly unresolved without fabricating consensus.
Freeze a distribution-preserving final label snapshot signed by both dedicated adjudicators without imposing a synthetic consensus score.

source_boundary.primary_reference: A dataset of rated conceptual arguments
source_derived_elements: Initial raters remain blind to other raters' judgments.
Large disagreements are discussed through object-level considerations rather than pressure to match another score.
Interpretation of positions and critiques is a major source of hard-to-resolve disagreement.
Original ratings are always preserved when a later object-level reconsideration produces a new rating.
Some residual disagreements may remain after discussion and should not be hidden.
metaphilosophy_specific_extensions: Deterministic critique-level case identifiers and case-set commitments.
Conflict-aware balanced assignment across exactly two dedicated adjudicators.
Versioned quality-controlled case-resolution records with prohibited score-imposition fields.
Explicit closure as unresolved when object-level disagreement remains.
Distribution-preserving final snapshot commitments and two-adjudicator sign-off.
Candidate honorarium-unit events that never authorize payment.

case_generation.case_set_commitment: SHA-256 over the sorted individual case-packet hashes

hard_exclusions: topic family outside approved adjudicator coverage
prior label exposure to the position
adjudicator is one of the original case raters
adjudicator_assignment.assignment_method: deterministic least-loaded eligible adjudicator with secret-seed SHA-256 tiebreak

required_fields: one disposition and rationale for every operative route
interpretation, context, and verification notes where relevant
all accepted case rerating IDs up to review time
minority or alternative interpretation preservation acknowledgement
resolution_records.corrected_resolution_rule: A later resolution version may correct only an immediately preceding quality-control-rejected record; no record may follow an accepted closure.

accepted_rerating_must_be: from one of the two original raters
for the same position and critique
predecessor-linked to one of the preserved initial case ratings
supported by an object-level revision reason

final_label_snapshot.requires_all_cases: accepted closure or explicit unresolved closure
critique_record_binds: latest accepted rating IDs and hash
case and resolution IDs where applicable
final_label_snapshot.signoff_rule: Both dedicated adjudicators sign the exact snapshot-body hash once each.

public_summaries_may_include: case, resolution, dataset, and snapshot commitments
public_summaries_must_exclude: adjudicator, rater, participant, and operator identifiers
rating, case, resolution, and signoff identifiers
controlled case, resolution, snapshot, and signoff records
